extracted.name: Mint Chutney
extracted.description: A perfect mint chutney recipe. Cilantro, mint, and a hint of spice make this a magnificent sauce that goes well with lamb or Indian dishes.
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon tamarind juice or lemon juice
instruction_lines: Combine onion, cilantro, mint, chile pepper, tamarind juice, and salt in a food processor. Process to a fine paste, adding enough water to achieve a thick sauce.
